profile.headline: C++ Software Developer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
Two decades of experience in Architecture, Design, Implementation of C++ with added growth from using AI tools. An agile C++ developer with experience gained from both commercial and government facilities in requirements, design, and coding. 

- US Government Clearance
- Coach others in using Copilot
- Collaborative and skilled engineer
- Experience building reliable systems
- Great C++ analytical skills for backend software
- Self-motivated, set and drive toward goals
- Clean up undesired code and remove technical debt

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior C++ Developer of a Hardware Testing Project which is used to verify hardware and firmware of storage devices prior to making upgrades or huge purchase orders for Microsoft Data Centers. Work is based on feedback from hardware engineers using the testing product.
Established Unit Testing and Code Coverage Metrics for CI/CD. Prior to my arrival Unit Tests did not exist for my current project.
Provide requirements and review their code and tests for three other developers.
Provide training and guidance to interns working with Microsoft during their summer internship.
Basically, pulled a project out of the mud which no one else wanted to touch and now has a large user community in Microsoft.
positions.insights: Skills: Azure DevOps · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Software Design · Unit Testing · Software Development · Requirements Gathering · Software Infrastructure · Microsoft Visual Studio C++ · GitHub Copilot · C++ 20 · CPPCon

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead C++ Software Developer for the NOALS contract.  Establishing C++ Guidelines for the group, upgrading GCC from 4.8 to 6.3 for C++ version 14.  Introducing Test Driven Development Group (TDD) through Google Test Framework.  Refactoring current code to RAII principles, removed memory leaks through the use of smart pointers introduced Composite pattern which was used to reduce duplicity, demonstrated through the use of templates how to set up 100’s of static callbacks with the same class. Rewrote the makefiles for existing projects to allow for more flexibility to delivered products.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Software developer on OMS (Open Mission System) Verification Tool in support of Lockheed-Martin Skunk Works (ADP-LM Aero).  Introduced TDD (Test Driven Development) to the team through Google Test Framework which allowed the team to complete more of the project than expected. Convinced the team the solution is the Composite Pattern. Demonstrated how to use strong C++ types and merge sort at compile time. Designed and wrote our project makefiles.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Software developer for a corporate telephone security system.  Responsible for converting legendary ‘C code’ to C++ 11 using GNU Compiler Collection (gcc) to compile and test files.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected, planned and developed a Message Oriented Middleware Micro-Services Publishers for an ActiveMQ Server in C++ which is
translated binary files into a JSON format and is published as Non-Persistent ActiveMQ Topic on a classified network.
	Designed and developed ActiveMQ microservice in C++ which consumed XML data and on demand publish the data in JSON
	for another microservice to consume.
	Wrote my own test application for an ActiveMQ Consumer in JavaScript and used Websockets to (NodeJS) display my published objects on a Google Map.
	Designed an Object Pool Template used to de-code 200+ different types of messages inserted into a message stream.
	Software developed in a government classified environment (JWICS).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Game Developer for “Superman the Movie” and “Man Of Steel” video slot machine.
Interfaced daily with Artist, Technical Artist, Musicians, Mathematicians, Game Designers, and Project Managers to successfully develop games with shortened deadlines, changing requirements, and volatile hardware using MSVS 2008 as the development environment and delivering the product in Linux.
	Implemented automatic code update and build tool.
	Used Factory Patterns to replace giant sequence of if-else statements.
	Trouble shoot problems with the code library that works in both Win32 and Linux.
	Produced the first class UML diagrams for the companies Game Design Kit Library.  Allows developers and technical artists a better understanding of the code library.

projects.title: Project Euler
projects.description: Project Euler exists to encourage, challenge, and develop the skills and enjoyment of anyone with an interest in the fascinating world of mathematics.

projects.title: Systems Of Units (SOU) Library
projects.description: Introduction The Systems Of Units (SOU) Library was created out the author's desire to solve a problem where known engineering and scientific unit types will not be mixed to the wrong result type. The library automatically does unit conversions during compile time. The library provides strong type-checking of different unit types at compile time…
